text:
**1 — Scene:** A breakfast tray: toast, egg, muffin, avocado and lemon, with cereal, blueberries, packaged yogurt, a milky hot drink and a small bottle of milk. I include the dishes belonging to this tray.

**2 — Vessels:** Main plate approximately **24 cm** across, area **452 cm²**; cereal bowl **20 cm**, **314 cm²**; blueberry dish **10 cm**, **79 cm²**. The mug is approximately **8 cm** across internally, **50 cm²**; the milk bottle approximately **6 cm**, **28 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Toast, muffin, cooked egg, avocado, lemon wedge, dry cereal, blueberries, yogurt, milk, and a milky hot drink. No separate butter, oil or dressing is clearly visible.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy estimates:** Heights are average occupied heights. Bulk densities account for gaps only once.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Density (g/ml) | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast | Main plate 30% | 136 × 1.2 = 163 ml | 0.30 | 49 g | 265 | 130 kcal |
| Muffin | Main plate 12% | 54 × 3.5 = 189 ml | 0.40 | 76 g | 360 | 274 kcal |
| Egg | Main plate 17% | 77 × 0.65 = 50 ml | 1.00 | 50 g | 145 | 73 kcal |
| Avocado | Main plate 8% | 36 × 1.5 = 54 ml | 0.65 | 35 g | 160 | 56 kcal |
| Lemon wedge, including peel | Main plate 6% | 27 × 1.5 = 41 ml | 0.65 | 26 g | 30 | 8 kcal |
| Dry cereal | Cereal bowl 65% | 204 × 2 = 408 ml | 0.22 | 90 g | 380 | 342 kcal |
| Blueberries | Small dish 45% | 36 × 1.6 = 58 ml | 0.65 | 37 g | 57 | 21 kcal |
| Milky hot drink | Mug 100% | 50 × 4.4 = 220 ml | 1.00 | 220 g | 10 | 22 kcal |
| Milk | Bottle 100% | 28 × 5 = 140 ml | 1.03 | 144 g | 50 | 72 kcal |

The main-plate coverage totals **73%**, consistent with the visible uncovered areas. Cereal and blueberry coverage refer to their respective vessels.

The **sealed yogurt** cannot be measured from visible food area. Its small pot suggests approximately **100 g**, at roughly **95 kcal/100 g**; this is a packaging-based estimate, with greater uncertainty.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **927 g including beverages**, or **563 g excluding beverages**, and **1,090 kcal**. The main plate itself contains approximately **236 g**. The cereal and muffin account for much of the energy. A reasonable overall uncertainty is about **25%**, especially for cereal depth, muffin density and yogurt type.
